# Security Policy

## Supported Versions

| Version | Supported |
|---------|-----------|
| main branch | ✅ |

## Reporting a Vulnerability

**Please do not open a public GitHub issue for security vulnerabilities.**

Open a private [Security Advisory](https://github.com/Saiyam-Sandhir-Jain/approach/security/advisories/new) on GitHub, or contact the maintainer directly via GitHub: [@Saiyam-Sandhir-Jain](https://github.com/Saiyam-Sandhir-Jain).

Please include:
- A description of the vulnerability
- Steps to reproduce
- Potential impact
- Any suggested fixes

You will receive a response within 72 hours.
